summary: RFID textile laundry tags are flexible, fabric-encased UHF transponders designed to be sewn into garments, uniforms, linens and textiles. Thinner and more comfortable than rigid PPS or silicone laundry tags, textile tags are ideal for garments where wearer comfort and invisibility matter — staff uniforms, healthcare scrubs, hospitality linens and workwear.
